## Defined Outcome

The administrator Members page must reflow at narrow, tablet, and desktop widths. Its four account-state tabs, pending counts, member details, status badges, and existing access and role actions must not overlap or become inaccessible. Existing server behavior remains unchanged.

## Constraints

- Keep the change page-scoped unless the Design stage proves a shared primitive must change.
- Do not change account-state semantics, counts, search, pagination, action endpoints, authorization, data handling, or route contracts.
- Use synthetic local data only.
- Keep staging, production, and launch gates open.
